description: Recompute mouse direction tally including PMID:15905190 (contested positive) and PMID:17537992 (fratricide reframing)
code:
import pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, os
os.chdir("/tmp")
# Updated mouse-focused classification including iteration-3 papers
data = [
 ("15123744","Lee 2004","Inhibitory (refutes seed)"),
 ("15356144","Mooney 2004","Inhibitory (refutes seed)"),
 ("15870174","McNerney 2005","Inhibitory (refutes seed)"),
 ("15634901","Vaidya 2005","Inhibitory (refutes seed)"),
 ("16127454","Roncagalli 2005","Inhibitory (refutes seed)"),
 ("27573813","Guo 2016","Inhibitory (refutes seed)"),
 ("20363967","Fortenbery 2010","Inhibitory (refutes seed)"),
 ("27054584","Alari-Pahissa 2016","Activating - context (supports seed)"),
 ("20881194","Sinha 2010","Activating - context (supports seed)"),
 ("14666660","Johnson 2003","Activating - context (supports seed)"),
 ("15905190","Lee 2006","Positive but CONTESTED (fratricide; PMID:17537992)"),
 ("17537992","Taniguchi 2007","Qualifies/Neutral (reframes as fratricide)"),
]
df = pd.DataFrame(data, columns=["PMID","Study","Direction"])
tally = df.Direction.value_counts()
print("Mouse primary functional/genetic studies — updated direction tally:")
print(tally.to_string())
print()
for d,g in df.groupby("Direction"):
    print(f"  {d}: {', '.join(g.PMID)}")
df.to_csv("cd48_nk_direction_tally_v2.csv", index=False)

order=["Inhibitory (refutes seed)","Positive but CONTESTED (fratricide; PMID:17537992)",
       "Activating - context (supports seed)","Qualifies/Neutral (reframes as fratricide)"]
tally=tally.reindex([o for o in order if o in tally.index])
colors=["#c0392b","#e67e22","#27ae60","#7f8c8d"]
plt.figure(figsize=(8,4.5))
tally.plot(kind="barh", color=colors[:len(tally)])
plt.xlabel("# mouse primary functional/genetic studies")
plt.title("Mouse CD48/2B4 -> NK activation: direction of evidence (v2)")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig("cd48_nk_direction_tally_v2.png", dpi=130)
print("\nSaved cd48_nk_direction_tally_v2.csv + .png")
print("\nBottom line: 7 inhibitory vs 1 contested-positive vs 3 context-activating vs 1 reframing.")
